description: An elegant formal dining room inside what appears to be a heritage-style restaurant or event space, photographed at standing eye-level with a wide lens, showing the full length of the room in a one-point perspective composition. Walls are whitewashed exposed brick with warm ivory mortar lines, rising to a deep terracotta-plastered barrel-vaulted ceiling that glows with rich ochre warmth. Tall arched windows with black steel frames line both side walls, flooding the room with diffuse natural light filtered through pale muslin shades. The floor transitions from a patterned encaustic tile in terracotta and cream geometric motifs at the near end to grey chevron hardwood parquet at the far end. Round dining tables with marble tops are set with glasses and dried flower stems in bud vases on the left; long rectangular tables with dark upholstered banquette seating and black metal bistro chairs run the right side. Dark bentwood cafe chairs with cane seats surround the round tables. Three substantial suspended forms hang at even intervals above the central axis — wide, tiered circular glass-and-brass forms with multiple rows of faceted crystals and drops that catch and scatter light in all directions, their warm amber glow cascading across the terracotta ceiling and brick walls. The mood is festive, European-classical, and grand-bistro in character.
